label: MiniMax H3 Image T2I
description: The official MiniMax-H3-Image text-to-image graph (int8 DiT + Qwen3-VL-32B encoder, 6 steps, euler, cfg 1). The model is tuned for 2048x2048 of area: pick the 2K resolution tier. Your prompt is sent as written; turn on the switch on the subgraph node to have the prompt expander (Qwen3.5-9B) rewrite it into a detailed caption first, which adds a few minutes per image.
